messages:
Priya: Quick thought: instead of the usual 72h claim only, what if we trial a 'remediation escrow' model for followups? Assign to team escrow if no individual claims in 72h, then auto-rotate within that team.
Omar: Interesting. would help when ownership is ambiguous across services. how do you pick who from the team?
Priya: Minimal rules: postmortem lists a primary team (ex: infra, runtime). After 72h unclaimed, incident-bot creates an escrow ticket assigned to the team mailbox and pings that team. Team lead must pick an owner within 48h or the bot escalates to oncall lead.
Tess: Could add a small 'skill-tag' on followups (kv-cache, batching, infra) so the team can auto-suggest owners. avoids pinging random folks.
Ben: Also propose closure SLAs by priority to reduce drift: P0=48h, P1=7d, P2=30d. If overdue, increase visibility in weekly heatmap.
Anya: +1. the weekly heatmap would surface teams with recurring escrow assignments (signals a gap). would be nice to track recurrence_rate per team.
Omar: Automation notes: incident-bot can create escrow tickets with a short template:
```
- id: RE-2026
- primary_team: runtime
- skill_tags: [kv-cache, perf]
- created_ts: 2026-05-12T10:00Z
- due_sla: P1 (7d)
- status: escrow/unassigned/claimed/done
- verification: 7d error rate delta < 0.2%
```
Tess: small UX ask: when an escrow ticket is created, send a DM to top-3 oncall eligibles with one-click claim. reduces friction.
Priya: Good idea. And measure: escrow_rate (percent of followups that go to escrow), team_claim_latency, recurrence_rate_by_team. Pilot for 4 weeks.
Ben: If a team repeatedly gets escrowed items, we should trigger a 'capability review' runbook — pairing + doc backlog for that team.
Omar: One more: add a lightweight 'remediation-bank' where engineers can opt-in to accept 1-2 escrow claims per sprint as overflow. gives proactive owners.
Anya: Love the remediation-bank. Keep it opt-in and visible on the dashboard. add a small badge on profile (remediation-bank: yes).
incident-bot: Note: Creating escrow ticket template and DM flow is scheduled as a low-priority task (BOT-45).
Priya: OK team: Tess will prototype DM/claim flow, Omar will do the bot escrow ticket, Ben will draft SLA table and heatmap, Anya will add remediation-bank UX. Start next Monday; 4-week pilot and retro.
Tess: I'll post a short demo GIF of the claim flow once done.
Omar: Will open PR for bot changes mid-week.
Ben: SLA table + heatmap mock by Friday.
Anya: Thanks all. If pilot looks good, we'll fold escrow into the main followup process. Closing thread for now.
